verdict.rationale: Unity Catalog metric views let you define a metric once (e.g. revenue divided by distinct customers) and group it by any available field, with the query engine generating the correct computation. The docs present this as a semantic layer reused across queries and dashboards, and metric views can be queried from Power BI, Tableau, Sigma and other external BI tools. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that joins are declared in the model, documentation that Genie or other AI tools answer against metric views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
